convert_donut_checkpoint: convert a Donut checkpoint from the original donut-python library to a Hugging Face VisionEncoderDecoderModel
rename_key: rename a state dict key from the original Donut model naming convention to Hugging Face Transformers naming
convert_state_dict: convert an original Donut state dict to Hugging Face format by splitting QKV weights and renaming keys
get_configs: generate DonutSwinConfig and MBartConfig from an original Donut model's configuration
run_convert_cli: run the convert_donut_to_pytorch CLI tool to convert a Donut model with optional hub upload
